title.zh: SpaceX电话会：马斯克称明年算力规模有望超13吉瓦，ARR上看1万亿
title.en: SpaceX电话会：马斯克称明年算力规模有望超13吉瓦，ARR上看1万亿

current_state.zh: SpaceX reported Q3 2026 revenue up 161% to $14.58B and net income of $4.4B, while Musk outlined plans to exceed 13GW of AI compute by end-2027 and target $500B-$1T ARR, supported by a 440,000-unit Vera Rubin training cluster for Grok.
